title: M5-T173 part B2 (M5-T192) - section height-limit lines: the floor-stack section gains the lines read from answers.permitted_envelope (minimum base, maximum base, maximum building height) through an opt-in keyword; compact; default byte-identical
objective: (1) NEW kit/section_legal_lines.py: a pure reader returning the STANDARD-case height lines from results.answers.permitted_envelope (status 'available'; keys min_base_height, max_base_height, max_building_height; each a finite non-negative number in unit 'feet', with the document's own label and zr_sections). Nothing computed, no comparison with the building, no qualifying-housing keys, nothing from envelope_rows (they carry street-wall/setback/side-yard states, not heights). A missing or malformed key drops that line only; None when none survive. (2) kit/section.py draw_floor_stack(alternative, *, caption=True, legal_lines=None): with lines, the height axis scales to the higher of the building top and the highest line; each line dashed and labelled '{document label} {value} ft' at the existing label size; drawing height at most 260 pt; where the legal minimum-base line and the to_min_base top coincide, one line. legal_lines None is byte-identical (caption 'Drawn from the floor schedule; no placement on the lot.' kept). (3) kit/__init__.py render_floor_stack(alternative, *, frame='report', env=None, results=None): with results it reads (1) and passes the lines; omitted is byte-identical.
business_reason: Audit 2026-10-15c section 4: a compact section with the relevant levels and heights; legal lines only where supported. The draft read heights from envelope_rows, which hold none; the benchmark carries them in answers.permitted_envelope (30/45/55 ft, ZR 23-432).

acceptance_scenarios.given: render_floor_stack / draw_floor_stack without results or legal_lines
acceptance_scenarios.then: byte-identical; test_report_frame*.py pass unedited (rework3:109 caption kept)

acceptance_scenarios.given: the benchmark Building B and its results
acceptance_scenarios.then: three dashed lines 'Minimum base height 30 ft', 'Maximum base height 45 ft', 'Maximum building height 55 ft' (expected from real-lot.json row L3 and the ZR 23-432 capture, never a program run); storey tops 10/20/30 ft kept; height at most 260 pt, width at most 515.9 pt; one line at 30 ft; every number a document number

acceptance_scenarios.given: one state per row: permitted_envelope not available; a key missing; a value NaN, infinite, negative, a string, a boolean; unit not 'feet'; only qualifying-housing keys
acceptance_scenarios.then: that line omitted (None when none survive), never a default; a table of states in the test

acceptance_scenarios.given: envelope_rows with setback (applies or not_applicable) and street-wall rows
acceptance_scenarios.then: no setback or street-wall line on the section; heights only; no rule evaluated
identical to the render without results

risks: RISK 1: the section is a renderer, never a law source: no code compares the building with a limit; the setback state on page 6 is part B3's pointer to the appendix item.
RISK 2: the qualifying affordable/senior heights (65 ft) are not drawn for the standard Building B.
path_notes: Parallel part (with B1, B3, B4). Interface with B3: render_floor_stack(..., results=None); B3 checks the keyword by signature, so the two land in either order. D-093: values from the results document, checked against real-lot.json row L3 and the ZR 23-432 capture; NB-06 read only. No register entry cites a drawings module.
